LanguageData.VRE_AcidBlood.description: Carriers of this gene have a highly concentrated toxin in their blood. When bleeding, they emit large amounts of tox gas, and upon death, their gear will be destroyed by acid.
LanguageData.VRE_AcidBlood.label: acid blood
LanguageData.VRE_AntimicrobialPeptides.description: Carriers of this gene regenerate their tissue at a much faster rate than normal, and are much more capable of fighting off any infections and illnesses.
LanguageData.VRE_AntimicrobialPeptides.label: antimicrobial peptides
LanguageData.VRE_ChelisInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.descrip: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of insectoids of the Chelis geneline.
LanguageData.VRE_ChelisInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.label: chelis geneline skin
LanguageData.VRE_CompoundEyes.description: Carriers of this gene have numerous independent photoreception units allowing them to see in many directions, notice very fast movements and recognize details from afar. Their sight and effective shooting range is greatly increased.
LanguageData.VRE_CompoundEyes.label: compound eyes
LanguageData.VRE_CompoundEyes_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have numerous independent photoreception units allowing them to see in many directions, notice very fast movements and recognize details from afar.
LanguageData.VRE_CompoundEyes_Cosmetic.label: compound eyes, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_CuticleShell.description: Carriers of this gene grow a thin cuticle exoskeleton shielding protecting them from any pathogens. This provides them with immunity to common illnesses such as malaria or flu. Does nothing to prevent the infection.
LanguageData.VRE_CuticleShell.label: cuticle shell
LanguageData.VRE_DetoxifierTubules.description: Carriers of this gene have their Malpighian tubules set to overdrive and are capable of withstanding extreme amounts of toxicity without any ill effects.
LanguageData.VRE_DetoxifierTubules.label: detoxifier tubules
LanguageData.VRE_Dormant.description: Carriers of this gene have reduced activity and aggression and spend most of their time in a dormant state. Metabolism of such an individual is also reduced, allowing them to consume less nutrition to keep themselves alive.
LanguageData.VRE_Dormant.label: dormant
LanguageData.VRE_Eyes_Gray_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have pale white-gray eyes.
LanguageData.VRE_Eyes_Gray_Cosmetic.label: gray eyes, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_Eyes_Red_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have deeply red-pigmented eyes.
LanguageData.VRE_Eyes_Red_Cosmetic.label: red eyes, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_HardenedChitin.description: Carriers of this gene have their exoskeleton consisting of thick, hardened chitin, and are much more resistant to damage and stagger effects. This comes at the cost of slowing them down slightly due to the sheer weight of the carapace.
LanguageData.VRE_HardenedChitin.label: hardened chitin
LanguageData.VRE_Headbone_CenterHorn_Cosmetic.descrip: Carriers of this gene grow a single horn protruding from the center of the forehead.
LanguageData.VRE_Headbone_CenterHorn_Cosmetic.label: center horn, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_Headbone_MiniHorns_Cosmetic.descript: Carriers of this gene grow two small horns protruding from the forehead.
LanguageData.VRE_Headbone_MiniHorns_Cosmetic.label: mini horns, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_Heatshock.description: Carriers of this gene produce a special kind of heatshock proteins when hot, allowing them to survive even the most extreme temperatures, but causing them to consume a lot more nutrition.
LanguageData.VRE_Heatshock.label: heatshock
LanguageData.VRE_Heatstress.description: Carriers of this gene experience heat stress when temperatures exceed their optimal range for physiological processes. This can lead to cellular damage, including denaturation of proteins, burn damage and a severe fear of fire. They will lose consciousness when exposed to extreme heat even for a short duration.
LanguageData.VRE_Heatstress.label: heatstress
LanguageData.VRE_HighGreyMatter.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of absorbing new information at an incredible rate, analyzing their experiences and learning from them with ease. They are incredibly good at learning new skills and knowledge.
LanguageData.VRE_HighGreyMatter.label: high grey matter
LanguageData.VRE_Hiveglands.description: Carriers of this gene have special glands that allow them to greatly increase construction speed. They do however generate filth every time they construct anything.
LanguageData.VRE_Hiveglands.label: hiveglands
LanguageData.VRE_HypothermicHibernation.description: Carriers of this gene enter a hibernation if their temperatures drop below a certain point for too long. They will rapidly lose their body functions and fall into a deep sleep, which prevents any sort of frostbite damages but also makes them unable to do anything.
LanguageData.VRE_HypothermicHibernation.label: hypothermic hibernation
LanguageData.VRE_HypothermicSlowdown.description: Carriers of this gene do not suffer hypothermia. Instead, they enter hypothermic slowdown - a special biological state that allows them to survive extreme cold. Instead of trying to stay warm, the carrier’s body chemistry adapts to prevent internal freezing despite very low temperature. Bodily functions are slowed and capacities are reduced, but the cold does no permanent damage.
LanguageData.VRE_HypothermicSlowdown.label: hypothermic slowdown
LanguageData.VRE_Immunodeficiency.description: Carriers of this gene regenerate their tissue half as fast as normal and are much more likely to die from infection due to low immunity.
LanguageData.VRE_Immunodeficiency.label: immunodeficiency
LanguageData.VRE_InefficientMidgut.description: Carriers of this gene have a very inefficient acid in their midgut, making it harder to absorb nutrients. They will become hungry significantly faster, but they will be able to consume more.
LanguageData.VRE_InefficientMidgut.label: inefficient midgut
LanguageData.VRE_InflexibleJoints.description: Carriers of this gene have hardened, less flexible joints, making it much harder to move and even harder to navigate difficult terrain.
LanguageData.VRE_InflexibleJoints.label: inflexible joints
LanguageData.VRE_InsectAntennae_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene grow small antennae at the top of their head. These antennae do not serve any known function, and can be safely assumed to be cosmetic-only.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectAntennae_Cosmetic.label: insect antennae, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_InsectMandibles.description: Carriers of this gene have very strong, insect-like mandibles, allowing them to consume food significantly quicker. They will also be able to use these mandibles in combat if unarmed.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectMandibles.label: insect mandibles
LanguageData.VRE_InsectMandibles_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have very strong, insect-like mandibles.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectMandibles_Cosmetic.label: insect mandibles, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_InsectWings.description: Carriers of this gene grow large insect-like wings at the back of their torso, allowing them to move quicker, glide through difficult terrain with ease, and from time to time enable them to leap into the air.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectWings.label: insect wings
LanguageData.VRE_InsectWings_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene grow large insect-like wings at the back of their torso.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectWings_Cosmetic.label: insect wings, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_JellySacks.description: Carriers of this gene have large jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen, allowing them to periodically produce valuable insect jelly.
LanguageData.VRE_JellySacks.label: jelly sacks
LanguageData.VRE_JellySacks_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have large jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen.
LanguageData.VRE_JellySacks_Cosmetic.label: jelly sacks, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_KemiaInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.descript: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of insectoids of the Kemia geneline.
LanguageData.VRE_KemiaInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.label: kemia geneline skin
LanguageData.VRE_LowGreyMatter.description: Carriers of this gene are unable to process new information and are incapable of evaluating their decisions and learning from them. They are incredibly slow at learning new skills and knowledge, and have greatly lowered psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.VRE_LowGreyMatter.label: low grey matter
LanguageData.VRE_LowOctopamine.description: Carriers of this gene produce very little octopamine, causing decreased arousal and reducing their activity level. The lack of this neurotransmitter will also make them much more depressed.
LanguageData.VRE_LowOctopamine.label: low octopamine
LanguageData.VRE_MegascarabInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.des: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of megascarabs.
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderHorns.description: Carriers of this gene grow two strong horns from their forehead, similar to those found on bioengineered megaspiders. These horns can be used to maul enemies in combat if unarmed, but they also increase mining speed slightly.
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderHorns.label: megaspider horns
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderHorns_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene grow two strong horns from their forehead, similar to those found on bioengineered megaspiders.
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderHorns_Cosmetic.label: megaspider horns, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.des: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of megaspiders.
LanguageData.VRE_NuchadusInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.descr: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of insectoids of the Nuchadus geneline.
LanguageData.VRE_NuchadusInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.label: nuchadus geneline skin
LanguageData.VRE_OcelliEyes.description: Carriers of this gene have an optical arrangement composed of a single lens and without an elaborate retina, making them almost blind.
LanguageData.VRE_OcelliEyes.label: ocelli eyes
LanguageData.VRE_OcelliEyes_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have an optical arrangement composed of a single lens and without an elaborate retina.
LanguageData.VRE_OcelliEyes_Cosmetic.label: ocelli eyes, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_Parthenogenesis.description: Carriers of this gene can self-impregnate, creating offspring without a second parent. Specialized reproductive organs generate a fetus internally, which is stored in an ovipositor-like structure until ready to be birthed. It enables carriers to rapidly propagate their species autonomously.
LanguageData.VRE_Parthenogenesis.label: parthenogenesis
LanguageData.VRE_PollutionDependency.description: Carriers of this gene need to be affected by pollution on a regular basis to survive. After 5 days without pollution, carriers will suffer from pollution deficiency. After 30 days, they will fall into a coma. After 60 days, they will die.
LanguageData.VRE_PollutionDependency.label: pollution dependency
LanguageData.VRE_PorousSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have hollow pores in their skin, making them look extremely unappealing.
LanguageData.VRE_PorousSkin.label: porous skin
LanguageData.VRE_ProteinDenaturation.description: Carriers of this gene have disrupted cellular processes caused by denatured proteins that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are intensely sensitive to sunlight and have very dry chitin that’s susceptible to fire.
LanguageData.VRE_ProteinDenaturation.label: protein denaturation
LanguageData.VRE_RapidLifeCycle.description: Carriers of this gene have a short life cycle and will suffer age related illnesses sooner than others. The older they get, the more rapidly they will age.
LanguageData.VRE_RapidLifeCycle.label: rapid life cycle
LanguageData.VRE_RipperBlades.description: Carriers of this gene have long and deadly ripper-blades instead of hands. While the blades greatly lower work speed, they can be used in melee combat and are capable of ripping even armored enemies in half.
LanguageData.VRE_RipperBlades.label: ripper-blades
LanguageData.VRE_RobustMidgut.description: Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold midgut, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all. Prevents food poisoning.
LanguageData.VRE_RobustMidgut.label: robust midgut
LanguageData.VRE_SensitiveBrainGoop.description: Carriers of this gene have a volatile substance surrounding their brain, greatly increasing their psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.VRE_SensitiveBrainGoop.label: sensitive brain goop
LanguageData.VRE_Serotonin.description: Carriers of this gene produce large amounts of serotonin, keeping them in a continuous state of bliss while also affecting their consciousness. The presence of this neurotransmitter will also make them more aggressive.
LanguageData.VRE_Serotonin.label: serotonin
LanguageData.VRE_SlowedLifeCycle.description: Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia, and age much slower.
LanguageData.VRE_SlowedLifeCycle.label: slowed life cycle
LanguageData.VRE_SpawningSack.description: Carriers of this gene have large royal jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen. It increases their fertility and allows them to rapidly progress their pregnancy, and in case of chestburst pregnancies, it allows the carrier to carry their own spawn inside of them without the risk of death upon giving birth.
LanguageData.VRE_SpawningSack.label: spawning sack
LanguageData.VRE_SpawningSack_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene have large royal jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen.
LanguageData.VRE_SpawningSack_Cosmetic.label: spawning sack, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeHorn.description: Carriers of this gene grow a singular, thick horn in the middle of their headbone, similar to the ones found on bioengineered spelopedes. Unlike the megaspider horns, spelopede horn cannot be used in combat, but it does increase mining speed greatly.
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeHorn.label: spelopede horn
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeHorn_Cosmetic.description: Carriers of this gene grow a singular, thick horn in the middle of their headbone, similar to the ones found on bioengineered spelopedes.
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeHorn_Cosmetic.label: spelopede horn, cosmetic
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.desc: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of spelopedes.
LanguageData.VRE_Stenothermic.description: Carriers of this gene can only tolerate a very narrow range of temperatures.
LanguageData.VRE_Stenothermic.label: stenothermic
LanguageData.VRE_VatGrownInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.descr: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of vat-grown insectoids.
LanguageData.VRE_VatGrownInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.label: vat-grown insectoid skin
LanguageData.VRE_VestigialTubules.description: Carriers of this gene lack any capability to filter out toxins as their tubules have become functionless. They are much more likely to die due to any sort of toxicity in their environment.
LanguageData.VRE_VestigialTubules.label: vestigial tubules
LanguageData.VRE_VocalChitters.description: Carriers of this gene have their vocal cords changed into little openings in the bones, resulting in them being unable to speak, unless someone understands the loud whistling that they can now produce.
LanguageData.VRE_VocalChitters.label: vocal chitters
LanguageData.VRE_VocalGlands.description: Carriers of this gene have a special vocal organ that can emulate human voice perfectly, and emit a melodic tone that for most people can be described as beautiful.
LanguageData.VRE_VocalGlands.label: vocal glands
LanguageData.VRE_WeakenedChitin.description: Carriers of this gene have their exoskeleton consisting of thin, porous and brittle chitin, and are prone to damage. The light weight of their carapace, however, allows for a slightly faster movement speed.
LanguageData.VRE_WeakenedChitin.label: weakened chitin
LanguageData.VRE_XanidesInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.descri: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of insectoids of the Xanides geneline.
LanguageData.VRE_XanidesInsectoidSkin_Cosmetic.label: xanides geneline skin
